summary.text: Michelle Stith is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 primary.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described a career in the environmental and pharmaceutical industries followed by community volunteering and service on town boards in Windham.

paragraphs.text: Stith was born in Elizabethtown, Kentucky, and earned a bachelor's degree from Centre College in 1995.
In the 2024 survey, she said she grew up on a family farm in Kentucky and earned a degree in chemistry.

Stith said in that survey that she became a stay-at-home parent after her career and volunteered with organizations including the Friends of the Library of Windham, the PTA and Windham Athletic Boosters.
She said she has served two terms on the Nesmith Library Board of Trustees, including as chairperson, and is chairperson of the Zoning Board of Adjustment.
She listed funding public schools and protecting natural resources among her key campaign messages.
